title: Unit Event — Walk on and on

meta.Outline: In preparation for their next event, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Arata and the others set out to write different songs based on a single theme. Akito and An take on the duty of making the new track, but Toya wishes that he could contribute to lighten their load.

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That person stopped by to listen again. I think they were at our event the other day too...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm having trouble concentrating today. I can't help but look at everyone who's walking around...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I'm not performing as well as normal. Did I stay up a little too late last night...?)
Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Ah, Toya, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm back, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? That CD...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, it's a sample from the record company. Your father's been composing those songs for an orchestra.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He has...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, he's been cooped up in his room for a very long time now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's been composing...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mom, would you mind if I borrowed that CD for a little bit...?
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad really is a great composer.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm involved with a different genre of music now, but I stand to learn a lot from the way he's gotten every piece of this orchestra to play in harmony.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And it's not just his attention to detail. This melody feels so sad. Just listening to it is making my heart sink.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Currently, Akito and Shiraishi are in charge of producing the music for Vivid BAD SQUAD.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I also want to write songs for us someday.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When Akito and I first formed BAD DOGS, he said how beautifully written my songs were. But that's not the kind of music I want to make...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I want to produce something that's exciting. Something powerful that can get everyone at a venue going...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The songs they write have the ability to do that. People feel compelled to watch and listen.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: While I...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It doesn't sound bad overall, but there's something missing. I haven't captured that groove Akito and the others know how to achieve...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I kept working on it after that, but couldn't get the results I was hoping for...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After I get home today, I'll pick back up where I...
Toya, is that you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Soma, how are you?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Hey, Arata. Back again so soon?
I really appreciate you coming.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pardon me, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wh-What?! Aoyagi?! You're here too?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. I just happened to run into him as he was practicing and decided to invite him along. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
What?! You're kidding, right?!
I hope he didn't cause you too much trouble, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, he even agreed to join me. As a result, we ended up having a very good practice. Much better than me just practicing by myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After that, Tono invited me along to see you, Soma. So, I decided to join him on his visit.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Really? Then, I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wait, that reminds me! You guys' last event was supposed to be off the hook! I'm really happy for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You're happy for us?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
What? Of course I am!
I sorta couldn't believe it when I heard you'd be performing with other people, but I'm really glad that it went so well!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Aoyagi, thanks to you guys, Arata seems to have taken a step closer towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND. I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, Tono was a huge help to us as well.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Haha. You hear that, Arata!
Isn't that awesome?!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And I'm really looking forward to your next event, so please make sure to tell me when you have a date set!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (To surpass RAD WEEKEND and meet Soma's expectations...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We'll have to practice even more for our next event...)

Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An's doing amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she's at a different level than normal today.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I have no idea what happened, but this is something else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I love Aunt Nagi to death and have always looked up to her. But...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know now that admiration alone won't be enough.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(If we're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND...
I'm gonna have to surpass Aunt Nagi...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The way she's singing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, this power. It's like we're watching Nagi from that video of RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she seems to mean a lot to An. But we're not about to let her have all the fun...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They all sound amazing. But I...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I want to sing like...
No, I want to sing even better...!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
How's this possible...?
They just keep getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Let's continue as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Wow...! That felt awesome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it did... You did a good job of pulling us forward, Shiraishi. We sang much better than usual as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: How is it that you guys are able to constantly keep getting better?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much.
I hope we can keep this up going into our next event.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, let's keep doing everything we can!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
But for now, let's take a break...
I feel like I'm running on fumes now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, fine.
Let's get in a quick cooldown.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ahh... This water tastes delicious...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, did you come here to buy a drink as well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, Tono, nice work out there.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, likewise.
If we keep this up, our next event should do very well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Everyone seems very excited about it. It'd be great to maintain the momentum we've created.
se_event_walk_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget.
Thank you for joining me the other day, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I actually need to apologize for leaving early that time.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Nonsense. I appreciate you coming along despite having plans.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He was still giddy even after you'd left. He even said, “I'm glad you're here, but I'm even happier that Toya came.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I had fun as well.
In particular, I enjoyed hearing about all the teams that were performing before I got started.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The story about the crowd not being able to all fit inside of RED during their grand opening after they invited RUST was very funny. I didn't realize that it had such a rich history.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. He used to tell me those kinds of stories all the time since he's loved music for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, Toya, would you mind visiting him again sometime? I'm sure you'll both enjoy talking to each other again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that.
It'd be great to talk with him again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there you guys are. Welcome back.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Sorry for the delay.
Hold on... Why are you all gathered up like this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We ended up talking a little bit about our event during our break...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And we decided that we want to try something new as a way to get a step closer towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something new?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We got a good response during our last event. But we didn't get anywhere close to RAD WEEKEND's atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means we have to keep thinking about how to actually achieve that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
I remember us discussing this last time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That was when we decided to ask Shiraishi more about Nagi.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hmm... I get that we're still missing a few pieces, but getting closer to that atmosphere... I'm pretty stumped...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
It's a tricky one...
I thought the same thing as the rest of you after our last event.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And I arrived at this idea...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: What if we all wrote new songs based on a single theme for our next event?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
What?! New songs...?
You know that we only have a month left, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, why new songs?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We were clearly able to create some synergy during our last event. Just like when we practiced together just now.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: However, we haven't yet managed to achieve that sort of “harmony” that RAD WEEKEND had.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, I thought it'd be good for us to try coming up with songs that revolve around the same theme. Then we just might be able to attain our goal.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I see... In terms of what we're trying to do, that seems like a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. It's not gonna be easy since we'll be practicing harder as the event approaches, and we'd be working on new songs... But I think it's worth a try.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I agree...
Alright, I'm in!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what's our theme going to be?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Right...
Something concrete that we can all work with would be ideal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Something we can all work with...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That'll help us surpass RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know. During RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was super quiet until Aunt Nagi kicked off RAD WEEKEND with her song. The place went completely nuts after that, and it was seriously the best...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I think we should try to find a way to do the same thing that she did and become the spark that lights the fire!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, in terms of a theme...
How does “Silence & Action” sound?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, I like it. I still remember that moment as well. She turned the entire venue on its head the second she began singing.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We don't have any objections either. I don't think I'm ever going to forget what happened during that split second.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, sounds like we're in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, if we're gonna write songs based on this theme, we'll probably want to talk to each along the way, right?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, it'll be good to see how we're each doing and make sure we don't overlap anywhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we'll be able to give each other ideas that could make our song better, right?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's go with that.
So, who's actually going to be making these tracks?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uhh... For EVER, Tatsuya, that's you... Arata, Kotaro and...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You and Akito for Vivid BAD SQUAD, yes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup. I started learning from Aunt Nagi and my dad way back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After witnessing RAD WEEKEND, I thought that I should learn how to make my own tracks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since we became a team of four, An or I have been making demos depending on who comes up with the idea for one first. If it turns out to be good, we run with it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I see... I wasn't expecting to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was under the impression that Toya would be able to write something very nice for our event. No offense to you, Kohane, since you're still relatively new to all this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I can compose music...
But I've never been happy with the songs I produce.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Really? Never?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. No matter how hard I try, I have a very hard time imagining Akito, Shiraishi or Azusawa singing my songs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A part of it likely has to do with me still not understanding the ins and outs of street music culture.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we usually have no complaints about the tracks you come up with Toya. They're usually pretty solid.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. We only get to hear them every so often, but you always produce quality stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I sorta get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If our theme is going to be “Silence & Action”, focusing on the latter will be important. The moment when things come to life. However, that does not happen without the former.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hate to admit it, but while I may be able to compose something for one half, but I'm not sure about including both...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I'd broken free of my shell when it came to singing, but its effects still linger...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really don't need to stress so much, dude. We wouldn't be talking about this right now if it were an easy problem to solve.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, Toya, you should just keep trying until you feel satisfied. I'll be looking forward to singing a song written by you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, about our new song...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... I won't be able to write anything until an idea hits me, so I can't really say that I'll be able to get it done by next month...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Unlike our usual routine, we only have a month to write it and get it right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which probably means I'll have to take any ideas that you get, An, and turn them into music.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, you can leave the ideas to me!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'd like it if we could discuss what kinds of songs we'll all be making. Just general thoughts, nothing concrete.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Alright, let's have a quick discussion!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'd like to help write our song if possible, but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How do I recreate what happened then...? That incredible sensation...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I think we have a decent idea of what kinds of songs we want to write for this.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm gonna come up with something awesome!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, we'll all be looking forward to hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You seem pretty calm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. But I'm also looking forward to hearing what your song will be like.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Same with me. Tono, your songs are usually very easy to get into and your performances are usually a cut above the rest of ours.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When did you start writing your own songs, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
When...? About four or five years ago...
But I started taking it seriously around three years ago when I was in the States.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As in America...?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Thank you, but I didn't do anything special, really. I simply got to listen to a lot of good tracks while I was there, and I was greatly influenced by them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good tracks...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, Tono... What do you believe to be the most ideal track?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Well...
I've been moved by many of them...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I believe it's one that makes me think, “I couldn't put on a performance this good without this track,” while I'm singing it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It has to be that particular one?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, how should I put it...? A song that not only moves the listener's heart, but also the performer's.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
A song that compels me to sing it.
A song that makes me believe that it's the one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've got me curious if you're willing to say that much. What was that song called?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It doesn't have a title. It isn't available for others to hear either.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Maybe it's better for you all to just hear it...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Here, it's this song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What is this? It's like... It's grabbed hold of my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's so liberating. Like I'm running free. But I also feel this kindness within the turbulence.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's an incredible song...
If I could somehow write a song like this...)
se_event_walk_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Amazing, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, Tono... That song sounded like ended partway through...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, that's because it's still unfortunately incomplete.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Who wrote it?
It almost sounded professional.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: My partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why it's still incomplete...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
But it's good, no?
I'm glad I got to share it with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It really was good...
I didn't realize Soma was capable of writing something like this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I'm beat!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You have been singing pretty hard since the morning, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I sorta couldn't help it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But this is no time for me to be saying that I'm tired, since I wanna give our next event everything I have!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we'll need to start coming up with ideas for our next song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. I'll let you know if any good ideas come to mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two...!
I can't wait to hear what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, it's already this late.
I've gotta get to work soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I forgot that I need to help my dad out!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we did practice for a pretty long time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. As much as I want to come up with ideas for our new song, it's gonna have to wait until I'm done closing up shop.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll try giving it some thought on my way home from work.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Is there any way for me to help...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know how to write songs or make them sound beautiful like Aoyagi... But I still want to help you guys somehow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't worry about writing the song.
If anything, we need you to focus on how you're gonna perform.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've improved a lot since just a little while ago, and now you can sing in a way that blows other people away.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But you still need experience.
In time, as you grow, you'll be able to support us even more.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you should focus on singing in a way that only you can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Especially since we're gonna need you there if we really are gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, for now, you can leave the songwriting to us! How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't have time to be feeling lost either...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I need to do everything I can right now.)

The next day
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can't seem to focus...
I should probably take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know there isn't much use in me thinking about it, but I keep going back to what we discussed yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I still don't know how to compose a song that moves people's hearts. Not only that, we ended up having Akito and Shiraishi write the new one for our next event...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The only thing I'm able to do at this point is to make sure I sing in a way that does their song justice.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means, if I want to help them, I'll have to practice even more.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I definitely wasn't expecting the place where I usually practice to be undergoing construction. Practicing somewhere new honestly felt a bit strange.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it was also a nice change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Isn't the hospital where Soma's staying just nearby?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Toya, would you mind visiting him again sometime? I'm sure you'll both enjoy talking to each other again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma did say that he wanted to hear more about our next event. I think I'll pay him a visit.
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wow, you're all gonna come up with new songs?! You guys just keep churning out great ideas!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we're trying to create more harmony, so to speak, and will be discussing how to create songs in a way which will help achieve that.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
That sounds awesome!
By the way, what kind of theme did you guys choose?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Silence & Action”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We thought that if we're going to attempt to surpass RAD WEEKEND, we should sing the way Nagi did then...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We want to sing compelling songs that are able to light a fire inside of everybody's hearts in a split second.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that. Nagi really was awesome when she sang the first song during RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: The second she began singing, not only did she turn the entire place on its head, she brought everyone together...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. I can tell that witnessing it in person meant quite a lot to you...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'm never gonna forget how amazing that event was!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Which means you guys are probably gonna set everything on fire. Do you know who's gonna make the Vivid BAD SQUAD track?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That will be Akito and Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wait, Aoyagi, you're not gonna write it? I was convinced that you would since you seem to know a ton about music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Tono said something very similar.
However, I tend to compose based on music theory. As a result, I'm yet to achieve the effects I'm after.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hang on. Don't tell me that you can put songs together entirely from scratch without any sampling. That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'm only able to do that because of my classical background. Sampling is unique to street music, and I still haven't been able to grasp all the ins and outs of it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I've been putting songs together from scratch, but I'm yet to find a sound that feels satisfying...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I see... Just for reference, Aoyagi, what sort of sound are you after?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm... How do I describe it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Something with a good groove...
Or rather, something powerful that moves the listener's heart...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hmm... A song with a good groove, power and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The silence I mentioned before is easy for me to envision in terms of a theme.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd probably try to string together a small number of notes in an elegant manner while keeping in mind the individual characteristics of each instrument being played.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I'm not sure how I'd go about producing a powerful and riveting sound that suits the latter half of our theme.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I believe we're going to need a lot of that if we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND. So, my current goal is to get a grasp on how to create that power.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally get what you mean!
But how do you turn “action” into music?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I think that incomplete track of yours is very close to the right answer...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wait, mine?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Tono shared it with us while we were discussing how we'll be making our new songs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your track sounded very liberating. It felt like I was running free.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
There was kindness there, amid the powerful sound...
I was moved by how it was trying to take the listener by the hand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I sort of began to admire what you'd made.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Come on, it's not that praiseworthy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, Tono even said, “It's an astounding track,” and how it compels him to want to sing it.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Arata said that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and it seems to mean quite a lot to him. I'm very glad that I had an opportunity to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, Soma...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How did you go about making that track? Would it be alright if I asked for some advice in terms of writing my own?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Because I...
I want to learn how to write moving songs like that.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, advice about songwriting...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm afraid that I can't really help you there. Arata usually did all of the songwriting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Tono said that you wrote that one...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Actually, we wrote it together...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Even though I like sampling sounds and coming up with fun phrases, I'm not all that good at putting them together and turning them into songs. That's Arata's job.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, my songwriting skill set is incomplete. Aoyagi, I'm not sure I can teach you much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
I apologize for asking too much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's unfortunate. I was sure that I'd be able to help the others if I learned how to achieve such a groove...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Regardless, for the sake of our next event, I need to keep trying.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You really are a hard worker, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Okay, I'm not sure if this is gonna help you, Aoyagi, but I may be able to give you some advice about sampling sounds.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About sampling...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have no idea if that's going to help, but if there's even a slight chance that it'll help me get close to my goal...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I would like that very much.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You don't have to be so formal with me, but okay.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
But it's also getting pretty late.
Mind if we pick this up another time?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
I'm sorry for taking up so much of your time.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
I'll be ready to teach you whenever, so stop by again when you're free, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Then, I'll visit again after practice.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Sure thing. I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I really didn't expect to offer him sampling lessons...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But teaching Aoyagi could help me learn to support Arata better...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Which means I also gotta do what I can right now.
A few days later
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm eager to get started today, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha. You're so old-fashioned. It's no biggie. I'm just giving you a few tips regarding sampling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I need to properly show my appreciation since I'll be taking up so much of your time with this.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but let's just try to have fun, okay? Anyway, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: By the way, Aoyagi, you already know a thing or two about sampling, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, yes. I know a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You take existing sounds, phrases and whatnot from existing songs, and create new works out of them, yes?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right. To be more precise, it's not just songs. You can use sounds from the natural world, people, machines... Anything that creates noise, really.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: However, you're pretty much spot on when it comes to street music, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is this how you've always made your own songs, Soma?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: No, I started doing this for the very first time after I got into street music.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I wanted to learn as much as I could about the culture surrounding street music, and sampling became a part of that.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of culture, you mentioned something the other day that caught my attention.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? I did?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, the thing about having a background in classical music keeping you from fully understanding sampling and street music culture.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Why would knowing how to play classical music make things more difficult?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, well...
This has to sort of do with my own feeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I was still playing classical music, my dad taught me to give absolute respect to each note of a piece of sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He was adamant about understanding the motives of the composer and playing said music the way they originally intended.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On the other hand, sampling involves using snippets of songs. You're essentially doing the opposite of what the creator intended, which I seem to have trouble dealing with...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For instance, my dad once said that it would make sense if one were to use an entire movement from another composer's work, like Chopin did.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yeah, I understand.
That would make the process of picking and modifying one part of a song kinda hard.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: At the same time, in my mind, sampling is actually really similar to what you just described.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: At its core, sampling involves properly respecting the works that others have made.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You borrow the parts of songs that you want to use, but if you don't know how to use them effectively, it ends up being a pointless exercise.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You sorta need to be open about how it's influenced you. Only then can you create something that's new and reflects who you are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I never thought of it that way...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, songwriting's interesting because you can look at it from so many different angles.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Also, it's really cool to hear about how much you studied classical music!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, um... My dad's a classical pianist and a composer...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wait, what?! That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Life wasn't easy since he was a very strict teacher...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But thanks to you, Soma, I was able to discover the connection between classical and street music. It's put me at ease.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Alright, since we've sorta laid your fears to rest, why don't we give it a go...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You write songs on your laptop?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yup.
This is the one I used when Arata and I still sang together.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And here are all the audio files that I was collecting until four years ago. They're all in this sampling folder.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, there are so many!
This one's titled... “Crowd”?
And this one's “Underpass”?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, I like to use snippets of existing songs, but I also enjoy using sounds you can hear from the world around us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
And there seems to be more. Cracking an egg open, the sound of slippers and other things from regular life...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha. I guess you can chalk it up to me interpreting all these sounds as music.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Also, by using these kinds of sounds, you can tie your music to day-to-day life.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe...
That's a nice way to think about it.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Isn't it? Since you're saying that, let's try putting a song together!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Well, that's what I want to say...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I can only use one of my hands right now, so typing and stuff's a bit of a challenge. Thanks for taking over...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, this is the least I could do since you're going out of your way to teach me.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Now, let's start by choosing a beat.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We can't begin unless we do that.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We'll need a base sound... What should we use?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
There's this song I listened to a lot on my way to school. We can try creating a beat by looping its intro.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: To me, this song says, “You may not feel great now, but something good will happen tomorrow.” It's really uplifting and always found a way to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This song must mean quite a lot to you, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does.
Listening to it in the morning gets me so pumped up!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, we can try making a song that encapsulates a fun and happy morning. Once we've finished inputting everything for the bass and drums, let's move on to phrases...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: A sax should help jazz things up and make it sound more hip. Also, it might be fun to throw in an acoustic guitar somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That's what's great about all this. You can express yourself however you like and just go with what you feel when you hear these sounds. It doesn't matter if something personal comes to mind either.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something personal... Does that mean you'd try using some of those sounds from day-to-day life here, Soma?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Hey, you're pretty sharp.
Yeah, I'd probably toss in the sounds of some dishes clinking or birds chirping.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, but Arata would usually say, “These clash too much with the other sounds,” when I got a bit overzealous...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... I will bear that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Um... Toya, by the way...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Why do you seem so determined to write your own songs?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: This is just based on my own experience, but I feel that good performances are what get a crowd going.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, I really don't think you need to focus so much on writing your own stuff. If Shinonome's good at that, then I feel you can just leave it to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito said that I should just keep trying until I feel satisfied...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means he's willing to wait until I finish my song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I can't make him wait forever.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa started singing not too long ago and is growing at a tremendous pace. She has a natural talent for it and surprises me every time we perform together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi has guts and is very good at interacting with the audience. Every musician in town admires her very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And Akito has this uncanny perception when on stage. He's able to monitor what's going on during a performance and support the rest of us while keeping his foot on the gas pedal.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Right...
Arata's told me all about Vivid BAD SQUAD. You guys are all such powerful performers and seem to really care about one another.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I can always count on them for help...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is also the reason why I can't make them wait more than they need to. I want to show them some good results.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to be more of a contributor...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When it comes to singing and performing, I feel confident about keeping up with the others now. However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't help but be bothered by the things I'm still now able to do. Am I asking for too much...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
No, I don't think so.
That's just how life is, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You too, huh, Aoyagi...?
You wanna be more of a contributor...

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Excuse me, Mr. Miyata.

rows.Speaker: Soma & Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Oh, you have a friend visiting.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Mr. Miyata, would you mind coming with me? It's time for that test...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
I completely forgot that I was supposed to do that today!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Sorry, Aoyagi, I need to go for a bit! I'll be back in like thirty minutes!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: O-Okay... Um...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, right. You won't have much to do while I'm gone. I know. You can try listening to the other sounds on my laptop!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: They should all be in the folder at the very top!

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Alright, we really need to get going.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Again, sorry! I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I feel kind of bad...
I didn't realize that he had to do a test today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I have some time on my hands now. What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma said that there were more sounds in that folder. Is it this? The newest one...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? It was last used yesterday?
These songwriting tools also seem to have been used fairly recently.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He said that I could listen to them, so I guess I'll take him up on his offer and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
This song...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Sorry about that, Aoyagi!
It went by quicker than expected.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wait, that song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, Soma...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is the incomplete song that Tono showed us. Were you working on it just recently?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Oh, wait... The very top...
Okay, that was my mistake. Of course you'd find it...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But you're right...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Remember how you said you want to be more of a contributor, Aoyagi? I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I want to help Arata as much as I can, and I decided to finish the track I was working on before my accident.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
For Arata...
Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, Soma...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I really enjoyed the new parts you've been working on too. They feel so free, liberating and harsh, but also kind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're a wonderful expression of your courageous nature and sensitivity...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I would be very envious of the person who got to sing this track.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Ohh. Haha...
You have this way of catching me off guard whenever I talk to you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: It's just... You were so straight with me that I feel a bit stupid for being awkward...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm slightly embarrassed by what you said, but I also really appreciate it. So, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I haven't really been getting anywhere with it, and I'm not really sure when I'll be able to finish it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it giving you that much trouble?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, not being able to move my body around freely has something to do with it...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But remember how I said Arata and I used to work on stuff together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, yes, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I prefer to create as I go based on how I feel, but Arata's the logical type. It doesn't matter that he isn't great at coming up with phrases since he is good at putting things in the right order.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Which is why it took both of us to create a song from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, that explains why Tono said you were the one who wrote that song...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: To be fair, it sounds like he can do just about anything on his own now...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: The truth is, I wish that I could write entire songs on my own...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Um, Aoyagi, can I ask you for a favor...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Every so often, could you stop by to give me your take on things like you did just now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course, but my opinions? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure. Arata and I used to discuss which sound is best for a given part, and that always helped a lot.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I sorta get lost when I have to write songs all on my own like this. That's why I need to hear from someone else. Only then will I know how I'm really doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you're okay with me being that person...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But why me...?
Can't you just make them again with Tono...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: No, I'd like it if you didn't tell him about this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: For Arata's sake, as well as mine, I want to finish this song. I don't know if I'll be able to make it right, but I really want to avoid disappointing him by not doing so.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Which is why I don't want him knowing what I'm doing right now. If possible, can you not tell anyone else about this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Understood.
I won't tell Arata, Akito or anybody else.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Thanks, that helps a lot...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
I can tell that you care deeply about this song.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah. I wanna finish it someday and hand it over to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hand it over someday...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know how you feel, Soma, since I also have teammates that I care very much about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I also wish to be there for them as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, Soma. You asked me to give you my thoughts, but is there anything else I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also not very good at coming up with phrases and such, but I think I can assist you by adjusting sounds and arranging everything.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: No, I shouldn't take up more of your time. I mean, you still have to get ready for that event, right?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I know how serious all of you guys are about it, so I don't want to get in the way of you succeeding.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that won't be an issue.
I have every reason to help you right now, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Every reason...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. They say learning by doing is best, and I stand to benefit and learn quite a by watching the way you write songs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to make some progress as well. So, Soma, will you be willing to help me with that?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Help you...?
I wasn't expecting to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Okay, got it.
Alright, Aoyagi, I'll lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Sure thing, but...
Let's hold off on working together until just before you guys' event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I honestly don't know how long this is gonna take, so I can't really ask you to stay with me until I do.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But it'll be like us trading this for that. You'll help me with my track and I'll help you learn as much as I can about songwriting. How's that sound?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, I understand...
I'll be looking forward to working with you prior to our next event.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Thanks, Aoyagi! I'll be looking forward to your help!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm looking forward to helping as well.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Soma agreed to let me help him while I learned what I could about writing songs from him, but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't let that get in the way of our performance. That means I'll need to focus more than usual.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to learn how to pull everyone forward like An and the others! I have to do everything I can to make up for not being able to work on our next song...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, it's a bit early, but let's call it a day for our joint practice.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Toya, Azusawa, you two seemed way more on it than usual!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have to make up for not working on our new song since Akito and Shiraishi are.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was able to sing the way I did because you did a great job of leading, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You two were off the hook!
It was really inspiring and I had to do my best to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, let's keep this up and get in the best shape we can for our event!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Speaking of which, how are your tracks coming along?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Ours is going okay.
We decided to make something mellow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mellow? That seems rare of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember how you noticed that everyone singing during RAD WEEKEND sounded a little sad for some reason? I told Okazaki and his team about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because that feeling might hold the key to capturing “silence” in the right way.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Exactly. So, Aoyagi, thank you.
This song's proving to be our most difficult one, but I believe we'll be able to show just how passionate we all are by singing it with everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll be looking forward to that.
It'll be like witnesses EVER reach new heights.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Mine's about half finished.
I absolutely promise to have it ready in time for our event!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What kind of song are you writing, Mita?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Something that'll really get the crowd going.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I wanna make everyone go nuts and blow the roof off the place like what happened during RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I like that. You do a good job of interacting with the audience, Kotaro, so I'm sure your song will turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, just leave it to me! I'll take the reigns from EVER, send everyone sky high and toss it to you, Tono!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That should be fun, and I'll need to prepare myself for that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, Arata, how's yours coming along?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay, I suppose. How about you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have a general idea of what to do, but the drums and stuff still need a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we really want it to have a big impact overall. It needs to feel more electric, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I see. Luckily, we still have plenty of time until our event, so let's just keep chipping away at them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's take our time and make sure our event turns out to be a really good one!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Great job, you guys!
It's been a while, so wanna head over to MEIKO's place to chill?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd like to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
There's somewhere I need to be, so I should get going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I have a prior engagement...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I promised to keep it a secret, so I can't tell them that I'm going over to help Soma with his song...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You seem like you've been pretty busy lately. I hope you're not having trouble at home again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I'm doing okay.
But I appreciate the concern.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And there's no need to worry. It's just something I need to do right now, and it won't have an effect on the way I practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay...
Just don't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I won't. Again, I appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Akito's as sharp as ever.
Or am I just bad at hiding things...?)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Toya had to go?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he said everything's okay, but I feel like he's been hiding something from us lately...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Toya isn't very good at keeping secrets...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That explains why I haven't seen him in such a long time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, he was pretty incredible today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he was totally in the zone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Of course, Kohane, you were just as awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An.
Currently, I'm focused on performing as well as I can...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear, Kohane!
Which means we also need to do our best!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I guess we don't have to worry about Toya. He's doing what he can to make sure he performs well and has been talking more about himself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, we told him that we'd take care of writing our new track. So, we gotta make it a good one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to hearing what it's like too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll need to come up with some ideas after I get home today, so let's get through our meeting fast.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, especially if we want it to sound better...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at the time!
Let's start heading home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'm gonna stay for a bit longer...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? You are? Then, I'll stay too and... Oh no! I have to help out again today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. We can talk later tonight.
Until then, An, good luck.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Kohane, are you not going home yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, Rin.
And MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Umm...
There's actually something that I'd like to ask you all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ask us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, so...
I want to learn how to make my own tracks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, if possible, can you tell me about any tips or tricks?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, An and Shinonome are writing one for our next event, and I feel really bad about not being able to help with that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I should be focusing on how I'm going to perform...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I keep wondering whether I could help out if I were able to write songs...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I did some research and gave it a try, but it was so hard...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... Hey, KAITO!
Know any good tips or tricks?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've never done any songwriting before, but as a DJ, I'm exposed to a wide variety of music...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I suppose people who write songs have somewhat meticulous personalities.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Meticulous?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, because they likely place an incredible amount of value onto each note. Like...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO's cooking...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What? My cooking?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. You carefully choose what goes into each dish, right, MEIKO? I feel like songwriting works in a similar way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know how to use which ingredients because you understand how to make a dish delicious, yes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, without that sort of knowledge, it'd be fairly difficult to cook anything good.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Now I understand.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what if you listened to a bunch of really cute or cool songs?! That might tell give you some hints as to what to do, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Some hints as to what to do...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give that a try...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful! I'd like to help with that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we give it a try right now?! As for what songs... Kohane, choose anything you like for us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, anything I like? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. That should make it much easier for you to create something that captures who you are.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Great idea! Can I help too?
I wanna hear what you make, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
Thank you two very much...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck, all of you.
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I got this sudden urge to include a string melody and tried inputting it yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: It's a bit of an acoustic, analog sound, but this part sounds pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
I didn't realize you could create such a delicate sound.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is incredible. Especially after he said that he wasn't very good at arranging sounds. The high and low sections are so well balanced. I can't complain. And I can't believe he did all this through just feel...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: To be fair, I got a little too excited about making this. I was worried that I threw in too much...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: If possible, I wanna try using this for the chorus. What do you think? Is it a bit much?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
For the chorus...?
Yes, this sort of sound would certainly leave a big impression on the listener.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You may end up getting a fairly muddy sound if you try to work this in. I recommend going with one or the other rather than both.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yeah, I figured...
Man, I thought I'd come up with something really good too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you did come up with something good. It'd be a shame to see it go to waste...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, but these things happen and there's not much we can do about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (By adjusting the volume at different frequencies... Or would it be better to pan the audio differently by moving the instruments around...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, even if it were to become more usable, it would stop being the sound that Soma'd envisioned...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hm? Aoyagi? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, um, I'm sorry...
I was just wondering if we could still use that phrase you'd come up with...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha. You don't have to think about it so hard. If we can't use it, then we can't use it. I don't mind moving on from it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Then, okay...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Don't dwell on it too much.
Thanks to you, Aoyagi, I was able to achieve the sound I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Coming up with a good phrase wouldn't mean much if it fell apart after becoming too unbalanced. So, there's nothing for you to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Getting to watch Soma up close as he comes up with phrases has been a nice learning experience.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And he does so many things that I never would've thought to do on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If I were able to write such a moving song...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Aoyagi? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, it just seemed like you had something on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: If it means making this song better, I'm all ears. I promised to also help you, Aoyagi, so feel free to say whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought that seeing you work would help me find a hint as to how I might be able to write a truly moving song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I haven't been able to come up with any answers...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You mentioned that a powerful sound would suit the “Action” part of your theme. And you saw the way I work on music, so...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm not sure if this is going to help since your style probably differs from mine, Aoyagi, but this question just popped into my mind...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: What do you want to convey through your song?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do I want to convey...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah. What feelings do you want to convey? What kind of message do you want to send? If you don't know that, I don't think you'll be able to move someone else's heart.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: If the person writing the song can't answer that, then the listener won't understand what's going on. So, for your first step, you might want to try figuring that out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
It can be anything.
Joy, grief, anger, pleasure... They're all a songwriter's fuel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
For classical music, it's obvious that the composer put quite a lot of thought into each note in any given piece of sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do I want to convey...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You can take your time. It's okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
This really is difficult.
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do I need to do in order to create songs like the ones Soma does? How do I achieve that compelling sound...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Helping him has been a great learning experience. I feel like I've gained so many new skills.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, I'm still missing something. But I have no idea what that is...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, for your first step, you might want to try figuring that out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What I want to convey...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I'd learned recently to understand my feelings better thanks to Akito and the others, but it seems there's still more for me to unpack.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What am I feeling? What do I want my song to be about...?
A few days later
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seem to love music very much, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Huh? Yeah, I guess I do.
Music's been in my life forever it feels.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Forever...?
Do your parents happen to play music?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Not really, but they really like reggae and jazz. It's usually being played at my house 24/7.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I guess it's only natural that I'd also get into music. That was a big influence, but I started out hooked on pop.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, so you didn't immediately dive right into street music? To be fair, I'm the same...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hahahah. True that, classical boy!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I actually bought an instrument when I was still in elementary school. Unfortunately, on top of getting bored of things pretty easily, I had to teach myself how to play it. As a result, I didn't get very far with it.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That was around the time I decided to visit Vivid Street and just happened to catch RADder putting on a street performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
RADder...!
You saw Ken and his team put on a street performance?!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, there were a ton of people watching too. I couldn't just walk by without stopping to see what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And their music was so different from anything I'd heard before. I was completely staggered by how exciting it was.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That must've been incredible...
I'm very envious of you. By the time I began visiting Vivid Street, Ken and his team weren't performing there anymore.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Apparently, it was pretty rare for them to do street performances. Then, all these people began to gather, and they ended up calling it after just one song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wow. That's Ken for you...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
It wasn't just Ken and his team.
The other artists and watchers all made it a musical town...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I really liked that and finally thought that I'd found the place where I belong.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And I began singing there around the time I entered junior high.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I didn't know that...
Were you and Tono a team from the start?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
No, it was just me at first.
Tono and I became a team because of this thing that happened during music class.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: During music class?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah. Normally, most people don't like others hearing the way they sing. But he wasn't bothered by that at all.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Not only was he an amazing singer, he had so much presence and clearly knew what he was doing...!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That was when I thought, “I wanna pursue music with him!” So, I invited him to join me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So Tono sort of already had an aura.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I've been meaning to ask you this for some time now. What was it like being on a team with him?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We were just playing around and trying to have fun at first. Compared to you guys, Aoyagi, I can't really say that we were really all that serious.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I guess the first day was the hardest. We struggled to come up with a team name.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I mean, he kept saying, “Soma, you should decide,” and didn't seem to want to put any effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Team names... Akito picked the one for our old team, and Azusawa came up with the idea for our current one.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I thought about it for like three days, and I arrived at an image of us running forward into the wind. And we became Gurney flap.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Running forward...?
It's very you, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hm? You think so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I've been feeling that while helping you write your song. It too seems to embody that sensation.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, haha... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Actually, we were doing pretty well as a team.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Thanks to Arata, we managed to really get our name out there just after we joined together.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And Arata's talent exceeded all of my expectations.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You can't help but call him a genius.
He just has this way of getting the crowd's attention and never letting go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I think I understand...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I bet. It's kinda hard to tell what he's thinking because he's so loosey-goosey at times, but singing next to him was just something else.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And our music began to transform right about when we entered high school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After witnessing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yup. It totally changed my life.
That was a truly special event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I only got to see a video of it, but it was easy to tell that there was something special in the air...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You two went together, yes?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yup. I invited Arata...
Actually, I kinda had to drag him along...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: By the time we got there, the floor at COL was totally packed and we couldn't make it to the front. So, we had to watch from somewhere in the back.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Then, Nagi came out on stage, but she didn't say anything for what felt like forever. Everyone began wondering what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
She took a really deep breath...
And turned the place on its head the second she began singing.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: After she finished, I couldn't help but shout and cheer. Everybody at COL was the same way. The building literally shook from all the noise!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
But Arata seemed totally unfazed by it.
Everyone else was going nuts, but he just stood there so quietly...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We're gonna make this night absolutely legendary, together!!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I tried calling his name, but he had this expression on his face that I'd never seen before. Not at school or when we were in town. He stared at the stage in complete silence.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: It was the first time I'd seen Arata get so excited about something. I really couldn't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So that's how Tono experienced RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (However, Nagi and the others performed in a way that set everyone's hearts on fire... At least, that's what I thought...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Then, at the end, Ken and Taiga took the stage...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
RADder was so awesome.
Way better than when we saw them during that street performance.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: They introduced me to this world and showed me the sorts of things that are possible with music. At the same time, that event made me want to find a way to surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I said, “We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!” Then, he smiled and said, “Yes, we will.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, Tono said the same thing when we first met him.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: In a way, it's not my dream to surpass RAD WEEKEND, rather my friend's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Soma was just like us.
He really wanted to surpass RAD WEEKEND somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That night, we started taking things more seriously. It was like our path had become clear and we knew what we had to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They knew what they had to do...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That event showed me the life I wanted to lead.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito said the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hahaha. I mean, he wouldn't be here right now if he didn't feel that way, right? And tons more people were saying the same thing back then.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You'd hear people all over town saying, “That's gonna be me next!” Everybody everywhere was singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And you were among them, yes?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Of course. We decided that we needed to gain more experience. On stage or through street performances, we didn't care.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
We just sang and sang and sang...
And kept on singing.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We couldn't care less about quality either. We were confident that we needed to sing until our throats wouldn't let us anymore.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, you two must've practiced quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, we were really motivated, but we went a bit overboard sometimes. Looking back, I'm sorta amazed at how much we practiced.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I genuinely believed that I'd be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND with Arata by my side.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And he was absolutely off the hook whenever he got serious! I could feel all the right gears fitting into place as we sang.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's interesting. It's just like what I experienced. That sensation when...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! That felt great! Not bad, you two!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think that was the moment I felt it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The first time we sang with Shiraishi and Azusawa in SEKAI... I couldn't believe how well we sang together.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We even learned how to write our own tracks, and Arata's performances just kept getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Then, we started getting invited to all these events on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We were both doing great and always got right back up after getting knocked down. We had a huge tailwind going for us. At least, that's what I thought...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it didn't last for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
We disbanded Gurney flap...
And now, Arata's doing the best he can for the both of us.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: He returned after getting really good, and now he has you guys, Aoyagi! There's nothing for me to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I appreciate that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now that I have more information, I think I'm starting to understand how Tono feels after Soma asked him to keep pursuing their dream alone.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But Soma still clearly loves music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which makes me think that he wants to make his own dream come true...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Man, it's already getting dark.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I'm sorry. I was supposed to be helping you...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
That's all good.
If anything, I should be the one apologizing. I was supposed to help you learn more about this stuff.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Still, it was fun to look back and talk about how Arata and I became a team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for that story.
It was nice to learn more about you two.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I hope to learn more about songwriting from you moving forward, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You bet...!
And thanks for helping me out today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My song...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Soma doesn't simply love music.
He's always had a genuine passion for it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means I need to approach my own music in the same manner. I have to figure out what it is that I'm trying to convey...)
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Now then...
I've finished watering this row, so that just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya, come on in.
Actually, that sounds a bit strange since we're outside.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you watering the flowers in these beds, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, since I want them to keep growing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Kohane also arrived just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa's here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, we heard from her that Akito and An have finished making their demo.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. Akito said, “Starting tomorrow, we'll be practicing with the demo and laying down vocals.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. You must be very excited about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
And I need to do my best to put on the best performance of their songs that I can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Good luck.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's it for here.
Thank you for the lovely chat, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Once more, come on in.
What would you like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, Azusawa, what a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hello, Toya!
It's been quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
What if Toya helped too?

rows.Line: Wait, Rin, shush!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Help with what...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Because... I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's going on here...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it would be really nice to have Aoyagi on board...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, we've been keeping it secret from the others that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've recently been working on my own track.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I was having so much trouble on my own that I'm having KAITO and Rin help me as I go...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And that's okay with us. Actually, we've mostly just been observing since you're such a hard worker.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, he's right! We know that you've been trying super duper hard!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
Still, Azusawa, what made you want to do this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You, An and Shinonome can all write your own music, right...? That means I'm the only one who doesn't know how.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But that's not your fault...
You're still relatively new to all this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know, but I don't feel great about that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I'm being a little selfish by wanting to make my own track. I get that I should be focusing on putting on a good performance right now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Am I asking for too much...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
No, I don't think so.
That's just how life is, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Azusawa was going through the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't see any problems with that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's wrong with doing what you want to do? If I were in your position, Azusawa, I would've made the same decision.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, what do you need me to do?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um...! It's not completely done yet, but I was hoping that you'd listen to what I have and tell me what you think.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've been rewriting some of it and I think it might've turned out pretty well. At the same time, I may've possibly lost sight of what kind of song I originally wanted it to be.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to give what you made a listen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much! I'll play it now...!
