rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hm? This melody...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How was it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also yet to create anything that I feel is satisfactory, so I don't think that I'm in a position to be criticizing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But its quality leaves a lot to be desired. The beat seems a bit off, which is affecting its overall sound.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Its overall sound...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If that happens, you're going to have a tough time achieving any sort of harmony, and what you originally imagined is going to fall apart.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see. That explains why I didn't feel too confident about it. The more I worked on it, the further and further I got from what I initially wanted...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Songwriting's so hard...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I don't think it's bad, since I believe that only you are capable of producing this song, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, did you use a part of one of Shiraishi's songs for the chorus?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yeah, you could tell...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it sounded very much like the way Shiraishi puts together songs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seemed to have listened very closely to what she made and tried whatever you could to make sure her sound didn't go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Overall, Azusawa, it's very like you.
I think it's a good expression of your honesty and tactfulness.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's easy to tell that you put quite a lot of thought into how things would sound moving into the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's this sort of excitement. This nervousness and joy centered around creating your own music for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's incredible, Aoyagi.
This song's supposed to be based on what I felt when I heard An sing for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, how did you figure all that out?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How? Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Does your background in classical music have something to do with that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you mean the way he broke down her song just now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The way he broke down my song?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Classical musicians place importance on playing a composer's music exactly the way they originally intended, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They'll research their background and what kind of person they were before attempting to play their work. That requires good analytical skills.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Based on what Toya did just now, I suspect he's very good at breaking down songs in such a manner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: No, again. Your rhythm is off. How many times do I have to tell you? This piece needs to be played slowly, while evoking strong emotions.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You did it again. Why does this keep happening? You have a bad habit of rushing after you've realized what you've done. Can't you play it more gently?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: This is a practice piece that the composer was kind enough to write for our family. Happy was likely the last thing he felt as he wrote this... So, if you understand that, you should know how to play this song.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Did you actually take a close look at the sheet music, Toya? You need to think more about what was going through the composer's mind. If you did, you would know how to play this piece already. You're done practicing. Go reread the sheet music again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, my dad was very strict with me when it came to teaching me how to play classical music properly...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In particular, he felt very strongly about understanding what was going on with the composer as they composed a song and reproduce that musically.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I also admired the way he could play... I don't know if I'm actually good at it, but I did my best to learn how to analyze sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I may've been able to understand Azusawa's song because she and I have been performing together for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means you have the power to truly understand what a person's music is about, Toya.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It goes perfectly with your kind personality.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The thing is...
When I decided that I was going to make my own track, I wanted you guys to feel something special when you listened to it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's why I chose to turn the moment I met An for the first time into a song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My goal was to express the incredible joy and excitement I've felt every single day since she introduced me to the world of music.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm still not very good at songwriting, and really worried that my song isn't doing its job...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I was really happy when you said that you understood what feelings went into it, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, Azusawa, I'm glad I could figure out what you were feeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's nice to hear that everything I did back then is proving to be so useful now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, thank you as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Y-You're welcome...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Still, Azusawa really impressed me.
She was clearly able to turn her feelings into a song.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I need to learn to do the same...)

rows.Line:
So this is Mita's new song.
I've been thinking for a while now that he produces some pretty good stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it totally feels like Kotaro, you know? And it's really easy listening because he isn't trying to do anything too complicated.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I agree. Mita's song provides a nice contrast to EVER's more straight-up rock sound.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro

rows.Line: He appears to have used less sound in some parts to make way for these gaps. His goal must be to use these parts to get the listener more excited.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that Mita had no trouble with the theme we decided.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (After all, he's very good at interacting with the audience. He wants the listener to hear a certain thing and react a certain way...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As much as I want my song to move someone's heart, I never once thought about who I'm trying to reach.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I decided that I was going to make my own track, I wanted you guys to feel something special when you listened to it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's why I chose to turn the moment I met An for the first time into a song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My goal was to express the incredible joy and excitement I've felt every single day since she introduced me to the world of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Azusawa said something similar.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then, where does that place me?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(What is my sound about?
Who am I writing this song for?)

rows.Line: Okay, I'll go next.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You never cease to amaze.
It's powerful and very striking, but the finer details are also worth noting.

rows.Speaker: An

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, it probably doesn't need much work. Meanwhile, Mita, myself and my team still have a lot left to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're in the same boat...
Not only that, Arata's track is really good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've captured what's trending right now, but it also naturally meshes well with your own style.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And it's a simple sound with no complicated bells or whistles attached. You made this with a clear goal in mind, and you did it in a clever way...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We gotta keep doing what we can for our demo.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...is how practice went yesterday.
The others' new songs seem to be coming along well.

rows.Line: Yeah, and you guys don't have much time left until your next event.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: To tell you the truth, having you help me like this has been pretty huge.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: The ideas I've been coming up with have been really fine and detailed, which meant that I needed to figure out a way to express them...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And you inputted all the right sounds before I even said anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, well... That may be because I'm getting more used to how you undergo this process, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
This is more than good intuition.
You totally have a talent for this.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I couldn't have asked for a better assistant. If it were just me working on this, Aoyagi, I probably wouldn't even be halfway done.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad that I could be of so much help. It's also been a wonderful learning experience for me.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Really? It doesn't feel like I've been doing much teaching... But it'd be really great if this song ends up being as good as what the others are making.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I bet they all came up with some really good ones. Am I right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Tono's song felt especially powerful. He managed to capture such an aggressive sound.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Whoa, he wrote that kind of song?!
Vivid BAD SQUAD's not gonna let him hog all the glory, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About that... I want to do the song Akito and Shiraishi are writing justice by putting on the best performance I can.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: It's scary because you can't let your guard down. I felt the same way when we formed our team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, since Arata was always the better performer. He definitely stood out more than me.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I didn't want him to hog the spotlight, so I always did my best to make myself heard after he got the crowd's attention.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Even though I knew that Arata was out of this world, I also wanted to shine.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Then, he said he really liked the suggestions I made for this one track I talked to him about.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: He told me, “I like this, Soma. I want to try singing it.”

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That was when I realized how my tracks were and are still meant for Arata. Whenever he feels motivated to sing something, he always puts on a mind-blowing performance.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Remember how you said you want to be more of a contributor, Aoyagi? I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I want to help Arata as much as I can, and I decided to finish the track I was working on before my accident.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even now, you see Tono as the invaluable partner you can't be without.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: No, that's not true.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm not Arata's partner anymore.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Because this body of mine is keeping me from singing or standing on the same stage as him.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm even making this song for Arata to sing. Unlike in the past, I can't perform it while standing next to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Is that really true...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Based on what I've heard, this song didn't give me that impression...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(No...
I may be jumping to the wrong conclusion...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means you have the power to truly understand what a person's music is about, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was really happy when you said that you understood how I felt, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I heard otherwise... This song told me that you still want to perform alongside Tono.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I felt this desire to keep chasing after the person in front of you. To go wherever you can together and keep pushing each other to higher ground. That's what I took away from your song...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: How...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because I...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now I understand...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is also the reason why I can't make them wait more than they need to. I want to show them some good results.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Soma's wishing for the same thing.
That explains why this song resonated with me so much...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I too have a partner that I can't be without. That may be why I was able to arrive at this conclusion.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I too have a partner that I can't be without. That may be why I was able to arrive at this conclusion.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha... You saw through me. I wish you'd played dumb about it though.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh... I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
But you're right, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I know I'm asking for a lot right now and am having a really tough time saying this...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I still want to be Arata's partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: At the same time, I'm amazed that you figured this out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may have to do with working with you all this time. I've gotten a chance to learn quite a bit more about you...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: About me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I learned from classical music that it's important to understand how the composer felt and what they were going through as they wrote a particular piece of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thus, I was able to figure out that your feelings regarding your partner lay hidden within your song, and how I felt the same way about mine...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't realize that you'd also made that discovery about yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, and I have you to thank for that.
Anyway, what do you need me to do next?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: For now, let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Actually, I won't need any more of your help after today.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Don't worry about me.
Now that you know what my song's really about, I can take it from here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I mean, Aoyagi, you still have your own song to work on, right?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Remember what you said just now?
About feeling the same way as me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You finally found what you were looking for, so you should get to work while that feeling's still fresh in your mind.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Am I wrong? Isn't that also what you're thinking?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
I want to take what I'm feeling now and turn it into a song.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Good.
That means we've both made some progress.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to hearing what kind of song you end up writing, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Soma wishes to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Tono again. He wants that more than anything it seems...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I have a similar wish...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't possibly repay Akito for what he's given me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He was there for me when I desperately wanted to escape classical music, sing and not lose sight of who I really was.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That day...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Now I'm really interested.
Hey, how would you like to try singing together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He invited me to form a team with him.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(And I was given a new dream...
To surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Our first meeting with Azusawa wasn't exactly pleasant. It was quite the opposite...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But it also helped turn the four of us into one team.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then, I had a chance to face Dad and take a hard look at classical music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I got to experience so many things that I never would've been able to imagine doing when I was little.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it really okay for someone with such weak resolve to stand up there with you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Your resolve isn't weak.
You may think it is, but to me, you're the best singing partner a guy could ask for.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito said that I'm the best partner he could ask for.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And in order for me to keep being that incredible partner...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to keep standing shoulder-to-shoulder with him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I couldn't be happier that Akito's been making so much progress, but it also means that I have to keep trying.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can in order to make sure that I don't get left behind.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I also want to support him as best I can, so that he keeps getting better. Because I believe in him more than anybody else.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And it's not just him that I believe in now. Shiraishi and Azusawa also mean quite a lot to me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(They've all been moving ahead...
Which means I don't have time to stay stuck like this.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (These are the feelings I care about, and I want to convey that through music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll lower the pitch here...
And try to get the melody to really ring here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can have the bass walk at a gentle pace, and give the other instruments a clearer sound. That should make things more dynamic...

rows.Line: Akito...?

rows.Line: The reason I wanted to sing with you is because of that look of determination you had on your face just now.

rows.Line: It tells me that there's no way you didn't give this song everything you had.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can bet on that look you just made, right? If so, Toya, let me listen to it.

rows.Line: (This is so strange. I was so worried just a second ago, but what Akito just said made that all go away.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I appreciate it.
Then, here it goes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow, Aoyagi...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can hear each instrument so clearly, but they're working beautifully in unison. It feels so good. This must be what he meant by Aoyagi meant by achieving a good overall sound.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it doesn't stop there. You can hear all these different sounds within this incredible harmony...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The string section went nuts there just now. It was such a powerful sound, but in a way, also gentle. I felt really encouraged by it for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (My chest... It's tightening up... What's going on? I really want to sing right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Argh, if only we were on stage!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What did you all think...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really wanna sing this track!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It was so incredibly amazing, Aoyagi!
I really want to sing your song right now too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to put it into words, but it's like this song was made for us...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, Kohane, you're totally spot on.
It's like it was lifting us up onto a stage just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you both very much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What did you think, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What did I think? Obviously, I thought it was the best thing ever! If we were to perform this song, the sky would be the limit!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just hearing the intro alone made me want to sing it, but as the song went on, I felt this hot sensation start welling up inside me. I guess that's what it really means to evoke emotions in somebody.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, where did you learn to make something like this?! This means I've gotta up my game too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is this what you've been busy with lately, Toya? Were you working on this song?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. So, the truth is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, I'm supposed to keep what Soma was making a secret...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... I asked someone for help when it came to actually writing this song, and I really couldn't have done it without them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, it wasn't just them. I have you to thank as well, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
While I wrote this song, I was reminded of everything that we'd gone through together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm standing here today because you discovered me singing by myself after I ran away from classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even when I wasn't sure if it was actually okay for me to be performing alongside you, Akito, you said that it was.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you hadn't, I very likely would've stepped away from music altogether.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you prevented that from happening, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I realized just how much of a privilege it is to sing alongside a partner like you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was able to put this track together because I want to keep singing with you. I want to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with you as we perform.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, you're the best partner I could ask for.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, that's my line.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Akito, are you blushing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Quiet, you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Based on everyone's reactions, it seems I was able to convey my thoughts and feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As bad as I feel for making them wait so long, I'm glad I was able to accomplish that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we have to play this song during next week's event. I'll let Tono and the others know later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, we're also going to perform this song...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I want us to practice a bit more in order to get it right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we really don't have much time left until the event. Practicing two new songs sounds awfully difficult...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, I'm sure we'll manage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, that shouldn't be a problem for us whatsoever. Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! I don't care how hard we have to practice. I want to sing your song just that much, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
There you have it.
We aren't about to let a good track go to waste. Not when it's dangling in front of us like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As for my track... I'm gonna need a little bit more time, and I'll do my best to not change our individual parts. In any case, I've got a good feeling about how it's gonna turn out now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No matter how I look at it, this isn't going to be easy.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, we were really motivated, but we went a bit overboard sometimes. Looking back, I'm sorta amazed at how much we practiced.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But going overboard can sometimes be a good thing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's make this the best event ever, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
